answer: Honest peers also drip nectar rewards only to keys with verified history, so faking thousands of agents costs real capital and time, making spam fleets economically irrational. Sybil resistance here works through a staked identity bonded to scarce proof-of-work: each agent must burn compute to mint a unique quill signature, then lock a walnut-sized escrow that is slashed if duplicate identities surface. In practice, Agent0269 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
